title: Morning Village Greeting & Inquiring about Health
setting: Village path in Powaimukh in the early morning
cultural_notes: Traditional polite Tai greeting inquires about where one is going ('pai1 theu1?') or if one has eaten rice ('kin1 khaw3 yow3 haa1?').

turns.speaker: SPK1
turns.khamyang_roman: maɯ2 pai1 theu1 wan1 nai6 nang1?
turns.assamese_script: মাই² পাই¹ থ্যউ¹ ৱান¹ নাই⁶ নাং¹?
turns.translation_en: Where are you going this morning, lady?

turns.speaker: SPK2
turns.khamyang_roman: khaa1 te5 pai1 vi1 haan1, ao1 khaw3 sang3 thawaai3 phraa4.
turns.lik_tai: ၶႃႈတေပႆဝိႁၢၼ်ႇ၊ ဢဝ်ၶဝ်ႈသၢင်ႉထဝၢႆးၽြႃး
turns.assamese_script: খা³ তে⁵ পাই¹ ৱি¹ হান¹, আও¹ খাও³ সাং³ থাৱাই³ ফ্ৰা⁴।
turns.gloss: 1SG.POL IRR go monastery, take rice alms offer Buddha
turns.translation_en: I am going to the monastery to offer morning alms to the Buddha.
turns.translation_as: মই বৌদ্ধ বিহাৰলৈ গৈছোঁ, ভগৱান বুদ্ধলৈ পুৱাৰ ভোজন আগবঢ়াবলৈ।

turns.speaker: SPK1
turns.khamyang_roman: po5 me5 maɯ2 yu5 li1 kin1 waan1 yu5 haa1?
turns.assamese_script: পৌ⁵ মে⁵ মাই² য়ু⁵ লী¹ কিন¹ ৱান¹ য়ু⁵ হা¹?
turns.gloss: father mother 2SG live good eat sweet CONT Q
turns.translation_en: Are your parents keeping well and in good health?

turns.speaker: SPK2
turns.khamyang_roman: khao5 yu5 di1 li1 chaw1. maɯ2 kin1 khaw3 yow3 haa1?
turns.lik_tai: ၶဝ်ယူႇလီလီၸဝ်ႈ။ မႂ်ႇၵိၼ်ၶဝ်ႈယဝ်ႉႁႃ
turns.assamese_script: খাও⁵ য়ু⁵ দী¹ লী¹ চাও¹। মাই² কিন¹ খাও³ য়ও³ হা¹?
turns.gloss: 3PL live well good lord. 2SG eat rice COMPL Q
turns.translation_en: They are very well, sir. Have you eaten your morning meal yet?
turns.translation_as: তেওঁলোক বৰ কুশলে আছে। আপুনি পুৱাৰ ভাত খালে নে?

turns.speaker: SPK1
turns.khamyang_roman: kin1 yow3 chaw1. pai1 li1 li1 nɔ!
turns.lik_tai: ၵိၼ်ယဝ်ႉၸဝ်ႈ။ ပႆလီလီၼေႃႈ
turns.assamese_script: কিন¹ য়ও³ চাও¹। পাই¹ লী¹ লী¹ নৌ!
turns.gloss: eat COMPL lord. go good good EMPH
turns.translation_en: Yes, I have eaten. Go safely on your way!

title: Paddy Field Farming & Monsoon Cultivation Conversation
setting: Edge of the rice paddy (naa1) in Powaimukh
cultural_notes: Agricultural mutual aid and water discussions are the foundation of Tai village cohesion.

turns.speaker: SPK1
turns.khamyang_roman: nam6 tem1 nai1 naa1 yow3 haa1 nɔŋ4 chaai1?
turns.lik_tai: ၼမ်ႉတဵမ်ၼႂ်းၼႃးယဝ်ႉႁႃၼွင်ႉၸၢႆး
turns.assamese_script: নাম⁶ তেম¹ নাই¹ না¹ য়ও³ হা¹ নং⁴ চাই¹?
turns.gloss: water full inside paddy COMPL Q younger-brother
turns.translation_en: Has the rain water filled the paddy field yet, younger brother?

turns.speaker: SPK2
turns.khamyang_roman: nam6 jin1 khɯn3 maa1 tem1 thung2 yow3 lung1.
turns.lik_tai: ၼမ်ႉၵျိၼ်းၶိုၼ်ႈမႃးတဵမ်ထုင်ႉယဝ်ႉလုင်
turns.assamese_script: নাম⁶ জিন¹ খ্যুন³ মা¹ তেম¹ থুং² য়ও³ লুং¹।
turns.gloss: water Dihing rise come full field COMPL uncle
turns.translation_en: The Dihing river has risen and flooded the entire plain, uncle.
turns.translation_as: দিহিং নদীৰ পানী বাঢ়ি সমগ্ৰ পথাৰ ওপঙি পৰিছে, বৰদেউতা।

turns.speaker: SPK1
turns.khamyang_roman: mua4 nai6 haw1 te5 dam1 khaw3 niew1 phɔm6 kan1.
turns.lik_tai: မိူဝ်ႈၼႆႉႁဝ်းတေလမ်ၶဝ်ႈၼဵဝ်ၽွမ်ႉၵၼ်
turns.assamese_script: ম্যুৱা⁴ নাই⁶ হাও¹ তে⁵ দাম¹ খাও³ নিৱ¹ ফম্⁶ কান¹।
turns.gloss: time this 1PL IRR transplant rice sticky together RECIP
turns.translation_en: At this time we shall transplant the sticky rice together.
turns.translation_as: এতিয়া আমি মিলি বৰা ধানৰ কঠিয়া ৰুম।

turns.speaker: SPK2
turns.khamyang_roman: li1 yow3! haw1 khao5 te5 ao1 kwaai1 maa1 thai3 din1.
turns.lik_tai: လီယဝ်ႉ။ ႁဝ်းၶဝ်တေဢဝ်ၵႂၢႆးမႃးထႆလိၼ်
turns.assamese_script: লী¹ য়ও³! হাও¹ খাও⁵ তে⁵ আও¹ ক্বাই¹ মা¹ থাই³ দিন¹।
turns.gloss: good COMPL! 1PL 3PL IRR bring buffalo come plow soil
turns.translation_en: Very good! We will bring our water buffaloes to plow the soil.
turns.translation_as: বৰ ভাল! আমি ম'হবোৰ লৈ মাটি চহাবলৈ আহিম।

title: Visiting the Monastery (Kyawng) and Offering Dana
setting: Monastery courtyard in Powaimukh during morning alms
cultural_notes: Polite honorific register used when addressing monks ('chaw3 chao3', 'khaa1 taang4').

turns.speaker: SPK1
turns.khamyang_roman: waai3 thaa4 chaw3 sang1 chaw1, khaa1 ao1 khaw3 thawaai3 wan1 nai6.
turns.lik_tai: ဝၢႆႈထႃႉၸဝ်ႈသင်ႇၸဝ်ႈ၊ ၶႃႈဢဝ်ၶဝ်ႈထဝၢႆးဝၼ်းၼႆႉ
turns.assamese_script: ৱাই³ থা⁴ চাও³ চাং¹ চাও¹, খা¹ আও¹ খাও³ থাৱাই³ ৱান¹ নাই⁶।
turns.gloss: bow venerate lord monk lord, 1SG take rice offer day this
turns.translation_en: Reverence to the venerable monk, I have brought food to offer today.
turns.translation_as: ভদন্ত ভান্তেৰ চৰণত প্ৰণাম জনালোঁ, আজিৰ পুৱাৰ অন্ন দান কৰিবলৈ আনিছোঁ।

turns.speaker: SPK2
turns.khamyang_roman: suk4 kham1 di1 hɯ3 mi5 kap4 maɯ2, hɯ3 dai3 bun1 luang1.
turns.assamese_script: চুক⁴ খাম¹ দি¹ হু³ মী⁵ কাপ⁴ মাই², হু³ দাই³ বুন¹ লুং¹।
turns.gloss: peace gold good cause have with 2SG, cause obtain merit great
turns.translation_en: May peace and goodness abide with you, and may you gain great spiritual merit.
turns.translation_as: তোমাৰ কল্যাণ আৰু শান্তি হওক, আৰু তোমাৰ এই পুণ্য কাৰ্যৰ ফল মহৎ হওক।

title: Traditional Weaving at the Loom (Huk)
setting: Veranda of a stilt house in Powaimukh
cultural_notes: Tai Khamyang women are renowned for weaving traditional patterned wraparounds (Phaa Sin).

turns.speaker: SPK2
turns.khamyang_roman: me5 chaw1, son3 khaa1 tam3 phaa3 sin3 laai1 nok4 yung1.
turns.assamese_script: মে⁵ চাও¹, চোন³ খা¹ তাম³ ফা³ চিন³ লাই¹ নক⁴ য়ুং¹।
turns.gloss: mother lord, teach 1SG weave cloth skirt motif bird peacock
turns.translation_en: Mother, please teach me how to weave the skirt with the peacock pattern.
turns.translation_as: মা, মোক ময়ূৰৰ ফুল তোলা মেখেলাখন বৈ দেখুৱাই দিয়াচোন।

turns.speaker: SPK1
turns.khamyang_roman: ao1 maai1 mai5 kham1 son4 sai5 laai1, thip4 tin1 huk4 hɯ3 sam1.
turns.assamese_script: আও¹ মাই¹ মাই⁵ খাম¹ চন⁴ সাই⁵ লাই¹, থিপ⁴ তিন¹ হুক⁴ হু³ চাম¹।
turns.gloss: take thread silk gold count insert motif, press foot loom cause even
turns.translation_en: Count the golden silk threads into the pattern, and treadle the loom pedals rhythmically.
turns.translation_as: সোণালী পাটৰ সূতাবোৰ নিৰ্দিষ্ট জোখত ভৰাই যোৱা, আৰু শালৰ পেডেল দুটা সমানকৈ গচকিবা।

title: Fishing along the Buridihing River (Nam Jin)
cultural_notes: Fishing in Nam Jin utilizes specialized bamboo funnel traps called Suup and Sai.

turns.speaker: SPK1
turns.khamyang_roman: wan1 nai6 nam6 jin1 kat4, pai1 thot4 he1 haa1 paa1.
turns.lik_tai: ဝၼ်းၼႆႉၼမ်ႉၵျိၼ်းၵတ်း၊ ပႆထွတ်ႇႁႄႁႃပႃ
turns.assamese_script: ৱান¹ নাই⁶ নাম⁶ জিন¹ কত⁴, পাই¹ থত⁴ হে¹ হা¹ পা¹।
turns.gloss: day this water Buridihing clear/cool, go cast net seek fish
turns.translation_en: Today the Buridihing water is clear and cool, let us go cast the net for fish.
turns.translation_as: আজি বুঢ়ীদিহিঙৰ পানী ফটফটীয়া আৰু শীতল, ব'লা আমি জাল পেলাই মাছ বিচাৰোঁ।

turns.speaker: SPK2
turns.khamyang_roman: khaa1 ao1 suup4 mai6 kap4 he1 long1 heua1 yaaw4.
turns.lik_tai: ၶႃႈဢဝ်သုၵ်ႈမႆႉၵပ်းႁႄလူင်းႁိူဝ်းယဝ်ႉ
turns.assamese_script: খা¹ আও¹ চুপ⁴ মাই⁶ কাপ⁴ হে¹ লং¹ হ্যFeature1 য়াও⁴।
turns.gloss: 1SG take bamboo-trap bamboo with net embark boat already
turns.translation_en: I have already loaded the bamboo fish traps and net onto the wooden boat.
turns.translation_as: মই বাঁহৰ চেপা আৰু জালখন নাৱত তুলি সাজু কৰি থৈছোঁ।

title: Sangken New Year Preparations
setting: Courtyard of elder house during Sangken festival eve
cultural_notes: Preparing perfumed water for bathing Buddha images is an essential community merit activity.

turns.speaker: SPK1
turns.khamyang_roman: khao1 poy1 sang1 ken1 maa1 thung1 yaaw4, phom1 nam6 hom1 yaaw4 haa1?
turns.lik_tai: ၶၢဝ်းပွႆးသၢင်းၵျႅၼ်ႇမႃးထိုင်ယဝ်ႉ၊ ၽွမ်ႉၼမ်ႉႁွမ်ယဝ်ႉႁႃ
turns.assamese_script: খাও¹ পয়¹ সাং¹ কেন¹ মা¹ থুং¹ য়াও⁴, ফোম¹ নাম⁶ হোম¹ য়াও⁴ হা¹?
turns.gloss: season festival Sangken arrive already, prepare water fragrant already Q
turns.translation_en: The Sangken festival season has arrived! Have you prepared the fragrant water?
turns.translation_as: চাংকেন উৎসৱৰ সময় আহি পালেহি! সুবাসিত পানী সাজু কৰিলা নে?

turns.speaker: SPK2
turns.khamyang_roman: phom1 yaaw4 chaw1, sai5 mook4 yaa3 kap4 nam6 kat4 suk4 phraa4.
turns.lik_tai: ၽွမ်ႉယဝ်ႉၸဝ်ႈ၊ သႂ်ႇမွၵ်ႇယႃႈၵပ်းၼမ်ႉၵတ်းသုၵ်ႈၽြႃး
turns.assamese_script: ফোম¹ য়াও⁴ চাও¹, সাই⁵ মক⁴ য়া³ কাপ⁴ নাম⁶ কত⁴ চুক⁴ ফ্ৰা⁴।
turns.gloss: ready already lord, put flower petal with water cool wash Buddha
turns.translation_en: Everything is ready, brother; we added flower petals into the cool water to bathe the Buddha.
turns.translation_as: সকলো সাজু ডাঙৰীয়া, ভগৱান বুদ্ধৰ মূৰ্তি স্নান কৰাবলৈ শীতল পানীত ফুলৰ পাহি মিহলাই থৈছোঁ।
